tdm.text: Mehtma of House Fenzala leads seven young charges into the Kin-Tree chamber to be accepted into the house as adults, though she resents teaching during the siege and longs to serve Khan Felothar.
As Sultai necromancy and artillery batter the city, she clashes with Jurjis, who is requisitioning her cows, and crawls beneath a fallen beam to rescue trapped youths, including Gohl.
Chasing Cemil to the ramparts, she overpowers him and learns that he was never House Fenzala but Sultai, and she realizes the cow ruse was a distraction to let House Agach into the Kin-Tree chamber.

In the sanctum she finds Jurjis kneeling by the body of young Enti and threatening to chop down the Kin-Tree, and with strength lent by Enti's ancestor-spirit she kills him with Cemil's Sultai sickle.
Afterward she persuades Councilor Dvujin to appoint her captain of logistics in exchange for burying Jurjis's corruption, and turns her weapons on her political rivals.
